note: Synthetic, non-private Discord-safe campaign message samples for the WP10 real googletrans benchmark. No user data, no real Guild/channel/message ids.

items.content: Welcome to the server! We are excited to have you here.
Our next community event starts this weekend. Bring your friends and join the fun. Prizes will be awarded to the top three teams.

The maintenance window begins tonight at 22:00.

During this time, voice channels may briefly disconnect. We appreciate your patience while we roll out improvements.

Thank you for being part of this community.
Hey <@123456789012345678>, welcome! Please read the rules in <#234567890123456789> and say hi to <@&345678901234567890> members.
Check out our new announcement at https://example.com/campaign?ref=discord for full details.
**Important:** the event is *tomorrow* at 6pm. Don't miss it -- bring a friend!

Run `campaign.publish()` to go live, or use the ```py
campaign.schedule(rrule="FREQ=DAILY")
``` snippet for recurring sends.
Hi {{member_name}}, your registration for {{event_name}} is confirmed for {{event_date}}.
Congratulations on leveling up <a:party:456789012345678901>! Keep up the great work <:star:567890123456789012>.

Hey <@123456789012345678>! Your event {{event_name}} starts <t:1735689600:F>. Details: https://example.com/e/{{event_id}} -- use `!rsvp` in <#234567890123456789>. See you there <a:party:456789012345678901>!
This is not an announcement to @everyone, just a note for the team.
Season 3 launches next month with new maps, ranked rewards, and a redesigned progression system for every player tier.
